description: Unlock the potential of your data with the Data Slicer visual, empowering you to seamlessly filter and visualize your data across various visuals within your reports. Having troubles filtering a huge amount of data due to complex data entry or confusing data management? The Data Slicer visual can effortlessly filter large datasets with its user-friendly interface and its easy data input and filter configuration. The Data Slicer visual stands out with a 2 Operation modes: choose between the operation modes “Text box” and “Interval” Bulk insert: seamlessly import data from spreadsheet software like Excel by copy/paste Interval selection: select a range of values by defining a min and a max value (compatible with text, numeric, date and datetime values) Quick menu: intuitive switches for essential functions such as applying filters, clearing filters, setting delimiters, and choosing operators Highlighted frame: Stay informed and in control with our interactive frame feature, designed to provide clear signals regarding the application of filters Responsive design: The layout adapts seamlessly to the size of the visual for an optimal viewing and interaction experience Input Output masks: Select different input and output masks to simplify working with dates Find the documentation on how to use the Data Slicer visual here: Documentation Data Slicer About SCvation: SCvation GmbH…
